project.title: Native existing-cookie authentication under control fence
project.goal: Authenticate signed session token against current locked DB rows and trusted clock
project.scope: R04/R13/R41 human-cookie integration only; full identity/runtime/platform remains pending

action.session_cookie.description: Verify active-key opaque cookie and resolve exact current session under control lock

errors.not_committed: Failure.stage=NotCommitted; structured error codes include access_denied, active_transaction, connection_refused, control_busy_or_unavailable, invalid_control, control_fence_required, company_busy_or_unavailable, company_write_lock_required or unchanged trusted callback Error; reuse flags govern retirement. Cookie/time refusal adds invalid_credentials and invalid_auth_clock; runtime configuration errors are invalid_auth_config before any transaction.
errors.outcome_unknown: Failure.stage=OutcomeUnknown with transaction_escaped or commit_outcome_unknown; retire/recover, no rollback claim.

preconditions: Explicit active injected key/profile/workspace, trusted runtime clock, stable admitted databases and manifest/lifetime, trusted callback.
postconditions: Only MAC-verified current unexpired ready human identity can authorize callback under same control lock; fixed errors and no secret diagnostics.

authorization.rationale: Cryptographic cookie is not DB authority; exact current token, expiry, freshness and membership must be checked under the held control lock, with no client actor/time fallback.

action.session_cookie.behavior: Bounded cookie/MAC verification then locked token/expiry/freshness lookup and shared company authorization/transaction

component.application.description: Native credential verification and locked session orchestration

boundary.responsibility: Native cookie proof plus locked session and transaction orchestration
boundary.rationale: Identity must be derived from credential bytes rather than a caller boolean.
excludes: Login/MFA/reset/recovery issuance, service credentials, CSRF, production runtime admission or endpoints

scenario.normal.description: Independent HMAC and actual Better Auth issued session authenticate same subject under current locked control policy.

scenario.given: Independent synthetic credentials and canonical control/effect stores.
scenario.when: Compare actual legacy authentication, native verifier and fenced credential entrypoint.
scenario.then: Independent HMAC and actual Better Auth issued session authenticate same subject under current locked control policy.
